sourceContext: R27 truthful final local schema and Hotel data-state certification with per-action proof, independent reviewers and real rollback recreation for release 698c.
objective: Complete truthful final local schema and Hotel data-state certification with per-action proof, independent reviewers and real rollback recreation for release 698c.
why: R27 proves local schema and bounded Hotel data-state certification on disposable PostgreSQL only, with durable per-action evidence and real rollback recreation.
scope: Apply ordered schema and ACL effects with data-state exclusions
acceptanceCriteria: Target reference build is persisted and resolves the release artifacts exactly once
Fresh candidate contract equals immutable baseline before mutation
Every reconciliation action records exact before and after postconditions and crash recovery is fail-closed
Independent RLS, RPC, storage, grant, constraint, migration and dependency reviewers have P0=0, P1=0 and P2=0
Candidate destroy and restore from the same verified backup equals baseline with no residue
Hotel DATA_STATE_PATCH effect hash is verified and executed only on a separate disposable local candidate with bounded-change and rollback evidence
Production reads and mutations remain zero
forbiddenActions: change Production RLS, grants, RPCs or schema
verificationRequirements: Record lifecycle journal without secrets or paths
Verify baseline immutability before and after extraction
Verify target artifacts resolve exactly once
Verify backup hash immediately before restore
Prove rollback recreation and zero residue
